DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-DRACONIC_BLOODLINE_REL:
ACT1: Gain 12 max HP.
ACT2: Gain 1 flight, refreshes when resting.
ACT3: Once per turn, after playing 4 elemental cards, gain 12 block.
Draconic ancestral blood flows through you.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.descr:
ACT1: When a spellslot reaches 0, add a random spell 
from your draw pile into your hand.
ACT2: Gain Potency based on the amount of status cards in your deck.
ACT3: Generating a status grants 1 energy.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.flavo: The power of the weave cannot be mastered, it is unpredictable
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.title: Wild Magic
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LUNAR_SORCERER_RELIC.d:
ACT1: Once per combat, when metamagic reaches 0, gain 2 energy.
ACT2: Heal 5hp when the last kill in an encounter is from spell attack damage.
ACT3: Playing a scrolled spell or a spell affected by your metamagic you draw 1 card.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LUNAR_SORCERER_RELIC.f: Power from the heavens, right in your veins!
